sources.evidence: UCG's current official page identifies OJSC "Kant Cement Plant" as a Kyrgyzstan cement manufacturer and lists current manufactured cement products, including CEM II/V-K (Z-I) 32.5H, CEM II/A-K(Z-I) 32.5H and Portland cement CEM I 42.5 N; product manufacture includes combined grinding of Portland cement clinker, gypsum and mineral components.

UCG's official 2025 notice states that a new dry-process production line at Kant Cement Plant was launched on 16 June 2025 and documents its rotary kiln, five-stage preheater, precalciner and roller press; commissioning began in April 2025 and the notice describes monitoring of all production stages through final cement packaging.

name: Kuvasaycement
products: Sulfate-resistant Portland cement with pozzolana CEM II/A-P 32.5 H SS (GOST 22266-2013)

sources.evidence: UCG's current official production page identifies JSC "Kuvasaycement", states that its production uses limestone, iron-containing components and gypsum stone, gives annual technological-equipment cement capacity, and lists Portland cement CEM I 42.5 N and sulfate-resistant Portland cement with pozzolana CEM II/A-P 32.5 H SS among current manufactured products.
The current official Kuvasaycement site identifies the plant in Kuvasay, Fergana Region, Uzbekistan and presents it as the operating cement enterprise under the 2026 site copyright.

name: Chekka cement processing plant
products: P 52.5 BTNa RMS, High Resistance Portland Cement

sources.evidence: Cimenterie Nationale's current official contact page identifies its Plant at Chekka, while the current port page explicitly identifies the cement processing plant in the town of Chekka, Northern Lebanon.

The current official manufacturing page documents the plant's raw-material extraction, crushing, raw-material drying/grinding, kiln burning that transforms raw meal into clinker, cement grinding, and cement packaging/delivery processes.
The current official products page lists PA-L 42.5, P 52.5 BTNa RMS, P 42.5, P 42.5 BTNa RMS, CS 42.5 ChB and CS 32.5 ChB cement products.

Cimenterie Nationale's current corporate page states it is currently a leading cement producer and describes today's production of high-quality cement products; its current site lists active manufacturing facilities and 2025 company news.
